card.name: Inside Indian personal names after titles
card.fires_on: Early pieces of South Asian personal names, mostly right after a title and initial such as Dr. T. or Dr. K. Seen in news-style text naming officials, doctors and leaders.

modes.label: After Dr. and initial
modes.description: The first piece of an Indian surname following Dr. and an initial.
modes.example: Dr. T.<< Pat>>anjali Sastry, President, Environment

modes.label: Later name pieces
modes.description: Middle pieces of a long Indian name already begun.
modes.example: said state swine flu coordinator Dr. K. Subh<<ak>>ar. Keywords: Medical facilities

modes.label: Other titled names
modes.description: Names after Prof., Diwan or a party-leader initial.
